title: Vengeance on Midian

questions.question: Who did God command Moses to avenge the people of Israel on?
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:2 (ESV): "Avenge the people of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people."

questions.question: How many men from each tribe were sent to war?
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:4 (ESV): "A thousand from each tribe of all the tribes of Israel you shall send to the war."

questions.question: Who went with the army carrying the holy vessels and trumpets?
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:6 (ESV): "And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest... with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets..."

questions.question: Who was killed along with the five kings of Midian?
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:8 (ESV): "They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword."

questions.question: What made Moses angry with the officers?
options: They let all the women live
questions.correctAnswer: They let all the women live
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:15 (ESV): "Moses said to them, 'Have you let all the women live?'"

questions.question: Why was keeping the women alive a problem?
options: These caused the people of Israel to act treacherously against the Lord in the matter of Peor
questions.correctAnswer: These caused the people of Israel to act treacherously against the Lord in the matter of Peor
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:16 (ESV): "Behold, these, on Balaam's advice, caused the people of Israel to act treacherously... in the matter of Peor..."

questions.question: How was the plunder to be divided?
options: Half to warriors, half to congregation
questions.correctAnswer: Half to warriors, half to congregation
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:27 (ESV): "Divide the plunder into two parts between the warriors... and all the congregation."

questions.question: What was the tribute from the warriors' half given to Eleazar?
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:28 (ESV): "And levy for the Lord a tribute... one out of five hundred..."

questions.question: What was the tribute from the congregation's half given to the Levites?
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:30 (ESV): "Take one drawn out of every fifty..."

questions.question: How many Israelite soldiers were missing after the battle?
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:49 (ESV): "Your servants have counted the men of war... and there is not a man missing from us."

questions.question: What did the officers bring as an offering for their safety?
options: Articles of gold (armlets, bracelets, signet rings, etc.)
questions.correctAnswer: Articles of gold (armlets, bracelets, signet rings, etc.)
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:50 (ESV): "And we have brought the Lord's offering... articles of gold..."

questions.question: What had to be done with metals (gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, lead)?
options: Make them go through the fire, and purify with water
questions.correctAnswer: Make them go through the fire, and purify with water
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:23 (ESV): "Everything that can stand the fire, you shall make it go through the fire..."

questions.question: Who specifically got the tribute from the congregation's share?
options: The Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle
questions.correctAnswer: The Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:30 (ESV): "Give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle..."

questions.question: How much gold was the offering to the Lord?
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:52 (ESV): "And all the gold of the contribution... was 16,750 shekels."

questions.question: Where was the plunder brought?
options: To the camp at the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho
questions.correctAnswer: To the camp at the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho
questions.explanation: Numbers 31:12 (ESV): "They brought the captives... to the camp at the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho."

key_verse_text: And they said to Moses, 'Your servants have counted the men of war who are under our command, and there is not a man missing from us.'
